mapper.sql: WITH LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS AS ( SELECT S.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), LATEST_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.UNIV_ID, H.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.UNIV_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), NEXT_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, H.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'READY' ), CURRENT_MONTH_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT H.UNIV_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) AND H.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), MEMBER_COUNTS AS ( SELECT M.UNIV_ID, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY M.UNIV_ID ), MONTHLY_REVENUE AS ( SELECT H.UNIV_ID, SUM(H.AMOUNT) AS CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY H.UNIV_ID ), FIRST_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.UNIV_ID, MIN(H.PAID_AT) AS FIRST_PAID_AT FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY H.UNIV_ID ), SCHOOL_DATA AS ( SELECT U.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, U.SIDO, U.ADDRESS, U.SCHOOL_PHONE, U.HOMEPAGE, LS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, LS.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE AS PLAN_PRICE, CASE WHEN LS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID IS NULL THEN 'UNSUBSCRIBED' WHEN LS.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND LP.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'PAST_DUE' ELSE LS.STATUS END AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, FP.FIRST_PAID_AT, LS.STARTED_AT, LS.NEXT_BILLING_AT, LS.ENDED_AT, NVL(MC.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT, NVL(MR.CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE, 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE, CASE WHEN CMP.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PAID' WHEN LP.STATUS IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED') THEN LP.STATUS ELSE 'NONE' END AS CURRENT_MONTH_PAYMENT_STATUS, NVL(NP.STATUS, 'NONE') AS NEXT_PAYMENT_STATUS, LS.PENDING_ACTION, LS.PENDING_ACTION_AT, LS.CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT FROM UNIVERSITY U LEFT JOIN LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS LS ON LS.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND LS.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = LS.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN LATEST_PAYMENTS LP ON LP.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND LP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN NEXT_PAYMENTS NP ON NP.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = LS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND NP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN CURRENT_MONTH_PAYMENTS CMP ON CMP.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_COUNTS MC ON MC.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MONTHLY_REVENUE MR ON MR.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN FIRST_PAYMENTS FP ON FP.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM SCHOOL_DATA
ORDER BY
MEMBER_COUNT ASC, UNIV_NAME ASC MEMBER_COUNT DESC, UNIV_NAME ASC CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE ASC, UNIV_NAME ASC CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE DESC, UNIV_NAME ASC UNIV_NAME ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, M.LOGTIME_AT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE = 'ADM' AND M.UNIV_ID = #{univId} ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_ID

WITH READY_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'READY' ) SELECT S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, S.UNIV_ID, S.MEMBER_ID, S.BILLINGKEY_ID, B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS PORTONE_BILLING_KEY, S.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE AS PLAN_PRICE, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, S.PENDING_ACTION, H.HISTORY_ID AS READY_HISTORY_ID, H.MERCHANT_UID AS READY_MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID AS READY_SCHEDULE_ID, H.AMOUNT AS READY_AMOUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = S.BILLINGKEY_ID LEFT JOIN READY_PAYMENTS H ON H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND H.RN = 1 WHERE S.UNIV_ID = #{univId} AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, PRICE, BILLING_CYCLE FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PLAN_ID = #{planId}, PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE', PENDING_ACTION_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NULL WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') != 'CANCEL'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET PENDING_ACTION = 'CANCEL', PENDING_ACTION_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NEXT_BILLING_AT WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND NEXT_BILLING_AT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(PENDING_ACTION, 'NONE') != 'CANCEL'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, AMOUNT, PLAN_NAME ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{univId}, #{memberId}, #{billingKeyId}, 'READY', #{merchantUid}, #{portoneScheduleId}, #{amount}, #{planName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}, PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID = #{portoneScheduleId}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELED', ENDED_AT = CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, NEXT_BILLING_AT = NULL, PENDING_ACTION = NULL, PENDING_ACTION_AT = NULL, CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT = NULL WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PENDING_ACTION = 'CANCEL' AND CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
